products.title: Warmachine: Dusk House Kallyss Core Expansion
products.body_html:
Harness dark power with a soulless force, perfect for mid-sized games and expanding the ranks of your House Kallyss army.

An ancient eldritch creature of immeasurable selfish pride, Hazaroth ventured from the darkness not for redemption, but for power in the wake of the gods’ fall. At his command stalks Israfyl, a ghoulish engine of annihilation armed with lethal serpentine blades.

Forming his shield wall are Soulless Guardians, spear and shield in hand, while Soulless Hunters strike from range with unnatural precision. Silent and swift, the Blademasters carve through enemy lines, unleashing disruptive arcane rifts when extinguished. Alongside them, masked Seeker Adepts and guiding Seeker Wardens — living Iosans allied to House Kallyss — bridge the living and dead, directing the Soulless in their unyielding advance.

What’s in the box?

  • Hazaroth, Narcissar of Ruin (Warcaster)

  • Israfyl (Character Heavy Warjack)

  • Soulless Guardians (Unit)

  • Soulless Hunters (Unit)

  • Soulless Blademasters (Unit)

  • Seeker Adepts (Unit)

  • Seeker Warden (Command Attachment)

Models supplied unpainted.

Please note, the chassis shown in the image for the Character Warjack may not be the correct variant you will receive. The image will be updated at a later date to reflect the correct chassis.

products.title: Warmachine: Dusk Fane of Nyrro Army Box – Court of Shadows
products.body_html:
Ruler of the Fane of Nyrro and the oldest eldritch in existence, Auricant Vorsalys has shaped the nature and ambitions of his many disciples for centuries. Vorsalys exercises supreme authority on the battlefield, his immense sorcerous power overwhelming his opponents to flay them alive. The few unfortunates that survive are left cowering in fear and entirely inconsequential to Vorsalys’ agenda.

Court of Shadows is an excellent entry point to Dusk Fane of Nyrro, providing you with a potent arcane force that excels in both Command and Skirmish level Warmachine games, as well as powerful options for constructing a larger army to take on bigger battles.

What’s in the box?

  • Auricant Vorsalys (Warlock)

  • Thaemara, Mistress of the Damned (Character Solo)

  • Horkos (Character Warbeast)

  • Strygon (Light Warbeast)

  • 3 x Lesser Eldritch (Solo)

  • The Devoted (Unit)

  • The Merciless (Unit)

Models supplied unpainted.

Want to get started with Warmachine? Check out the free app, including all the rules for your new army, list building tools, organised play resources, lore, and more

products.title: Warmachine: Magnus the Unstoppable and Invictus
products.body_html:
Celebrating 20 years of miniatures combat in the Iron Kingdoms...

MAGNUS THE UNSTOPPABLE & INVICTUS

A patriot, a traitor, a warlord — what Magnus has proven in all his incarnations is that he is unstoppable.

Now, as Magnus returns to the life of a mercenary, he is joined by his greatest creation.

Invictus is the first Super Heavy warjack ever to join the Warmachine battlefield. Magnus, along with Invictus, is available to leaders of existing MKIV as well as Prime Legacy armies. Note that Magnus does not replace a leader model, but is a solo that automatically comes with a super heavy warjack.

products.title: Warmachine: Stryker Chassis Variant
products.body_html:
The Stryker Chassis Variant is part of the Cygnar Storm Legion Core Expansion, but is also available to order individually.

(Warjack Weapons and Heads Not Included)

products.title: Warmachine: Abyssal King
products.body_html:
The Abyssal Kings are Gargantuan trolls that fight alongside the Southern Kriels Brineblood Marauders. Native to the deep, warm ocean off the coast of Alchiere, the Abyssal Kings fight with a variety of deadly attacks, including fists, tentacles, wielding a Bowsprit as a spear, and hurling jetsam as a ranged attack.

The model includes four customisable hard points—head, ship’s figurehead, and two tentacle weapons. Each head offers a different debuff against nearby enemy models—either a Paralyzing Gaze that saps DEF or Awe, which reduces enemy attack rolls by -2.

What’s in the box?

  • Abyssal King (Gargantuan) - 120mm base

Models supplied unpainted.

Shipping Date

Models will begin shipping w/c 23rd Sept

products.title: Warmachine: Meat Thresher
products.body_html:
Give the farrow enough scrap, a few questionable ideas and absolutely no concern for safety, and sooner or later you’ll end up with something like the Meat Thresher.

A triumph of questionable farrow ingenuity, this hulking battle engine barrels straight into the enemy with an enormous bladed drum, crushing and carving through troops as it goes. Anything fortunate enough to escape its path still has the spinning hailer above to contend with, pouring fire into the enemy as the machine rumbles forward.

It’s crude, brutal and really shouldn’t work as well as it does. To the rest of the Iron Kingdoms, the Meat Thresher is a rolling nightmare of blades, bullets and bad ideas. To the farrow, it’s a masterpiece.

What’s in the box?

  • Meat Thresher

  • Warmachine Base

Full rules on the Meat Thresher can be found FREE on the Warmachine App download now and begin building your Thornfall Alliance army.

products.title: Warmachine: Gravediggers Defenses Set
products.body_html:
With sandbagged barriers, spike traps, fire pits and powder kegs ready to blow, the Gravediggers defenses help your forces dig in and hold ground when it matters. They’re especially thematic alongside trenchline units and storm-worn terrain. Deploy your defenses onto the field when you take the ‘defenses’ command card.

What’s in the box?

  • Spike trap

  • Fire pit

  • Powder Keg

  • Three Barriers

products.title: Warmachine: Constance Blaize and Gallant (HIPS)
products.body_html:
This set contains the resolute mercenary Constance Blaize and her super heavy warjack, Gallant, to build, paint, and play. As universal mercenaries, this duo can be deployed in any Warmachine army.

What’s in the box?

  • Constance Blaize, Radiance of Morrow (Mercenary Character Solo)

  • Gallant (Mercenary Character Super Heavy Warjack) (Companion*)


*As a companion, Gallant can only be deployed alongside Constance

products.title: Warmachine: Emperor Carver Ultimus Esquire III & War Boar MMD47
products.body_html:
Emperor Carver Ultimus Esquire III & War Boar MMD47

Down, but not out…

After suffering life-threatening injury at the hands of the warcaster Asheth Magnus, Emperor Carver Ultimus Esquire III once again takes to the battlefield thanks to the surgery of Dr. Egan Arkadius. His destroyed body has been augmented with limbs of iron and steam. To complement Carver on the battlefield, Arkadius has produced the pinnacle of his fusion of meat and metal—the Most Massive Destruction. Together, they will grind all enemies of the Thornfall Alliance beneath an iron hoof.
